title: [epic] full-text search — index article subjects and bodies
description:
Why: NNTP SEARCH and JMAP Email/query currently support only header-level filtering (subject substring, from, date range). Full-text search across article bodies is a core usability feature for any serious reader. Tantivy is a pure-Rust full-text search engine well-suited for embedding.

What:
- Add a Tantivy-based search index as a new store in usenet-ipfs-reader.
- Index fields: message_id, newsgroups, subject, from, date, body_text.
- Updated on each article ingest: extract body text from the IPFS body block and add to the index.
- Expose via:
    NNTP: SEARCH command (RFC 3977 §8.7, currently unimplemented) with full-text support via free-text query syntax.
    JMAP: extend Email/query filter with a text property for full-text search.
    IMAP: SEARCH TEXT and SEARCH BODY commands (RFC 3501 §6.4.4).
- Configurable index path and maximum index size.
- Index is a cache: can be rebuilt from the IPFS article store if lost.
- Out of scope: relevance ranking and fuzzy search in v1; exact match and boolean operators only.
notes: Review converged after 2 round(s). Final review: stoa-32a269b6.
